input: Look into dual citizenship eligibility through my grandparents

gold.taskTitle: Research Dual Citizenship Eligibility Through Grandparents
gold.taskDescription: Investigate whether the user qualifies for dual citizenship based on their grandparents' nationality or country of birth.

questions.title: Which country's citizenship are you trying to obtain?
questions.description: Identify the specific country the user wants to claim citizenship from through their grandparents.

questions.title: Which grandparent are you basing this claim on?
questions.description: Determine which specific grandparent (maternal grandmother, paternal grandfather, etc.) the claim is being traced through.

questions.title: Do you know that grandparent's citizenship or nationality at birth?
questions.description: Establish whether the grandparent was a citizen of the target country at the time of their birth.

questions.title: Was your parent (their child) also born in that country?
questions.description: Clarify whether citizenship was already passed down one generation to the user's parent, which affects the eligibility chain.

questions.title: What documents do you currently have about your grandparent?
questions.description: Find out what records are already on hand, such as birth certificates, passports, naturalization papers, or marriage certificates.

questions.title: Have you already researched this country's jus sanguinis laws?
questions.description: Gauge how far along the user is in understanding the target country's citizenship-by-descent rules.

questions.title: Are you doing this yourself or hiring an immigration lawyer?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a self-guided research plan or guidance on finding professional legal help.
